name: Shortcut Creator
description: A utility for creating and deploying desktop shortcuts through Microsoft Intune as Win32 applications. Generates .intunewin files, detection scripts, and deployment instructions automatically. Supports URL, file path, and Microsoft Store app shortcuts with custom icons.
keywords: how to deploy desktop shortcut with intune
troubleshoot shortcut not appearing on desktop
install desktop link via win32 app
deploy url link to all users
author: Shehab Noaman

securityCheck.aiSummary: The codebase appears to be legitimate Intune/Graph-based admin tooling with two notable concerns. The Rename-Device-on-Shutdown workflow (Install.ps1 and Rename-Device-on-Shutdown.ps1) introduces a potential persistence/renaming mechanism that could disrupt management policies or cause naming conflicts if misused or misconfigured. Governance, configurability, and explicit restart handling are recommended. Other components perform standard device-category synchronization via Microsoft Graph and generate local reports; no evident credential theft, remote code execution, or hardcoded secrets detected.
